feature: Status Contracts RAM/CPU/NET resources and bounded Anchor funding
decisions: RAM slider: 100% current quota, 200% double, explicitly confirmed by user.
Known zero-code service accounts remain selectable and are excluded from contract totals.
RAM value is current replacement cost including system fee; testnet USD is a mainnet reference.
CPU/NET slider scales current TLOS stake; zero stake uses an explicit amount; capacity varies.
Fixed-debit eosio::buyram; payer-owned eosio::delegatebw with transfer=false.
Direct sponsorship creates no DAO RAM credit or account/governance authority.
Fresh published USD rate required within 900 seconds; prepared purchase lifetime 60 seconds.
Live chain, system code/ABI hashes, balance, unchanged action and signing context checked before broadcast.
Closed modal, navigation, account/network changes or cancelled intent block pending-signature broadcast.
Unconfirmed submission exposes transaction ID and blocks automatic retry; acknowledgement refreshes resources.
No new dependency, package pin, backend interface or contract changes.
